recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-20609 unless future terminology-source migration work moves the Timing Abbreviation CodeSystem out of the core build.
issue_request: FHIR-20609 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 MnM change request to add code C, Continuous frequency, to the Timing Abbreviations ValueSet for HL7 v2 TQ/TQ1 Repeat Pattern table 0335 mapping.
initial_application: Commit c4807a5165ee632872ef9f6289fee8e9e1abbb5f listed FHIR-20609 among MnM R5 changes and initially added a C-only timing abbreviation CodeSystem. Follow-up commit 6314862f6c410bf17b0136e5e54e1d20b7c2d5c3 moved that code directly into the timing-abbreviation worksheet in source/datatypes/timing.xml, which is the current source representation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Timing in the [types] section, so source/datatypes/timing.xml is in current build scope. Timing.code is bound to TimingAbbreviation, its example list includes C, and the timing-abbreviation worksheet contains C with display Continuous (frequency) and the continuous-service definition. Same-value-set issue FHIR-13520 is already represented on the combined branch and does not narrow or supersede FHIR-20609. Zulip background matches the Jira v2 Repeat Pattern 0335 rationale, and no Confluence reference or later conflicting decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current core source already satisfies the accepted issue; no source files needed edits.

related_jiras.note: A prior Published issue added other common timing abbreviations to the same Timing Abbreviations ValueSet and is already represented on the combined branch.
